} API reference BreadcrumbLink Renders an a by default; swap the element with the Base UI render prop to integrate a router link, e.g. render={<Link href="/docs" />}. Prop Type Default render React.ReactElement a Breadcrumb, BreadcrumbList, BreadcrumbItem, BreadcrumbPage, BreadcrumbSeparator, BreadcrumbEllipsis Semantic wrappers extending nav (labeled “breadcrumb”), ol, li, and span.
